notes.title: Hotfix V0.7
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Today we have a big hotfix for you which, for technical reasons, may weigh quite a bit (it will not increase the size of the game)

In this hotfix:

Game engine update to UE5.4.4 - making in-game physics to behave better and brings a number of improvements
We changed the decor mode from now on arranging furniture and plants should be much easier 
We have made improvements to the Equip mission and course
We have adapted the applications to 3440x1440 resolution and others
Fixed missing text in emails or placeholders appearing instead of mission instructions
We have fixed the key binding system - also made changes to the control system
Improved physics and falling objects under the floor
Improved display of values on the server
Improved mission cancellation system
We have updated the game thumbnail
Minor bug fixes

Thank you for your feedback and reported bugs!
We continue to work on fixes and new content (next content update will be on December 19)

See you soon!
ServiceIT Team
